In Search of The Excavation Team (2)

summary: Tarrel Rockweaver waits in the Wetlands for word from Merrin at the Whelgar Excavation Site. His wife has missed two weeks of letters, and he fears disaster at the eastern dig.

sections.title: A Husband's Dread
sections.body: Tarrel Rockweaver has heard nothing from his wife, Merrin, for two weeks. From her post at the Whelgar Excavation Site, she used to send him weekly letters about the work. Now Tarrel fears calamity has struck the camp. With dwarf authorities stretched thin, he turns to passing scouts to learn whether the diggers are still alive.

sections.title: The Whelgar Dig
sections.body: The Whelgar Excavation Site lies east in the Wetlands, where dwarves dig for ancient Titan relics and history. Crews working in the wild can face beasts and threats from below. The site is far from the main roads, and whatever stopped the letters has left the diggers beyond easy reach.

aliases: who gives in search of the excavation team
faq.answer: Tarrel Rockweaver is a dwarf in the Wetlands, worried because his wife Merrin has stopped writing from the eastern excavation site. He takes passing adventurers for scouts sent to investigate the silence.
Merrin Rockweaver is a dwarf archaeologist working with the Whelgar Excavation team east of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. She wrote regularly to her husband until something stopped her letters.

faq.q: Where is the Whelgar Excavation Site?
faq.answer: The Whelgar Excavation Site lies east of Menethil Harbor and southwest of Dun Modr in the Wetlands, among rocky ridges far from the main road.

faq.q: Why did Merrin stop sending letters?
faq.answer: Merrin stopped sending letters because a threat at the dig cut the researchers off from normal courier routes and camp life.

faq.q: Who is the 'Longbraid' mentioned by Tarrel?
faq.answer: Longbraid is a dwarven authority who promised to send scouts to check on the Whelgar Excavation team if contact failed. Tarrel assumes any capable adventurer who arrives to help was sent by Longbraid.

faq.q: Is the excavation site safe to approach?
faq.answer: No. The Whelgar Excavation Site lies in dangerous Wetlands wilderness, and whatever stopped the team's weekly letters threatens anyone who reaches the dig.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Explorers' League takes pride in uncovering ancient history. The distress of your kin at the Whelgar Excavation calls for your attention.
As an Alliance member, you know dwarven outposts and research across the marshlands help guard the Wetlands from the dangers of the wild.
